title: Scope Atlas Source Snapshot PR validation to governed heads
purpose: Prevent the historical ATLAS-WP-017 Source Snapshot exact-head validator from producing false failures on unrelated pull requests while preserving its exact governed PR heads, push behavior, and workflow_dispatch behavior.
invariants: Only the Source Snapshot workflow and CI-WP-010 metadata change.
On pull_request, Source Snapshot exact-head validation executes only for the exact ATLAS-WP-017, ATLAS-WP-017b, and ATLAS-WP-017c governed head refs.
The existing Source Snapshot validation steps remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
CI-WP-009 and the M3.3 delegated route remain unchanged.
No product/runtime/contract/source semantics or branch-protection behavior changes.
requiredEvidence: CI-WP-010 pull request shows Source Snapshot exact-head validation skipped rather than failed.
Static guard contains exactly the three governed Source Snapshot head refs.
Static proof that validation steps below the job guard are unchanged from baseline.
adversarialTests: An unrelated atlas/ATLAS-WP-019 pull request must not execute the ATLAS-WP-017 exact-scope assertion.
An unknown pull-request head must not execute the ATLAS-WP-017 exact-scope assertion.
Each of the three governed Source Snapshot head refs must still satisfy the job guard.
A push event must still satisfy the job guard regardless of github.head_ref.
A workflow_dispatch event must still satisfy the job guard regardless of github.head_ref.
independentReview: Repository governance and PR scope gate this two-file CI-only change.
The exact CI-WP-010 PR must demonstrate neutral skip behavior for the unrelated Source Snapshot validator.
rollback: Remove the job-level pull-request head guard and CI-WP-010 metadata; historical behavior returns, including false failures on unrelated PRs.
